name: Lap Timer
description: A big stopwatch with lap times, best and worst laps in colour, a pace bar against your best lap and saved sessions.
prompt: A lap timer: start, lap, stop and resume with big buttons, lap list with differences, best lap in green and worst in red, a bar that shows the current lap against your best, stats, saved sessions and sharing. It keeps running if you close the app.
author: gonzaroman
